node.statement: Product-norm step. Let C_r,e_r be witnesses from lem-compcb-rectangular-product and K_p=C_r+1. At every amplification and for e<=e_r, ||A dot B-AB||<=C_r*e*||A||||B||. The ambient extended epsilon-C*-multiplication bound and epsilon<=e then give ||A dot B||<=||AB||+C_r*e||A||||B||<=(1+K_p*e)||A||||B||.
